'''Jonathan Marchi''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[2000 Ottawa Grand Slam]] on 20 May 2000 with Throne Room mains, according to Alex Klammrodt's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d785">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-05-22-ottawa-ontario-5-20-99d785/ ottawa-ontario-5-20-99], DeckTech (Alex "-AvataR-" Klammrodt, 22 May 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-05-22-ottawa-ontario-5-20-99d785/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
